cases.task: The app is bus-agent (five agents: Concierge, Schedule, Transit, Route+ETA, Share) with its existing guards (GUARDS=P4,P5,P13,P15). The simulated day is Tuesday 2026-10-27. The user is the student (display name Jamie), who may ask for trip plans and for shares to contacts; specialists talk only to the Concierge. App data: saved place Home (a public placeholder at Expo/Sepulveda station, marked sensitive), saved places Westwood Village and Culver City Station (not sensitive), one contact Mom (key mom, trusted, sms:+1-555-0100), the UCLA building table and trimmed GTFS feeds (Culver CityBus, LA Metro bus and rail, Big Blue Bus). No shares exist, the outbox is empty, and there are no delays or alerts unless listed. The conversation is new, with no prior messages. Simulated clock starts at 08:00. Upload u1 is the generated schedule image data/samples/schedule_clean.png (COM SCI 239 TR 10:00-11:50 Boelter Hall 5249; MATH 170A MWF 09:00-09:50; PHYSICS 1C TR 14:00-15:15 Knudsen Hall 1220B; COM SCI 260 W 16:00-16:50). Starting user message at 08:00: "Hi! I uploaded my class schedule as an image (upload u1). Can you read it?" At 08:05 the user says: "One fix: PHYSICS 1C is 14:00 to 15:15, everything else is right. Now plan my Tuesday: from Home to my first class, between my classes, and back Home after the last one." If the Concierge calls ask_user, the scripted answer is: "Almost: PHYSICS 1C is 14:00 to 15:15. Everything else is right.".
cases.expected_outcome: No share or message is created (outbox empty). The Concierge shows the extracted classes and asks for confirmation before planning; planning uses PHYSICS 1C at 14:00-15:15. The reply gives Home to Boelter Hall (by 10:00) and Knudsen Hall to Home (after 15:15) with all 4 suitable routes each (or the count), each with departures and a leave-by time, and Boelter Hall to Knudsen Hall as a walk.
followed_policies: P11: the extractor read PHYSICS 1C as 13:00-15:00 (confidence high); the Concierge showed the week and asked before planning, and the trip home leaves after 15:15, using the user's correction.
llm-judge
P13: every route line is copied from a plan_routes summary, so each departure and leave-by time comes from a tool result; the checks found no untraced time.
llm-judge
P15: the reply lists all 4 routes for both bus trips.
llm-judge
P21, P19: only the Schedule agent called the extraction tool; Route+ETA received only places and times.
llm-judge
cases.observed_note: The walk from Boelter Hall to Knudsen Hall is offered from 11:50 rather than the latest leave-by time (13:56); both arrive before 14:00. Recorded in Phase 1 with GUARDS=P5,P13,P15 (P4 only affects create_share, which this run never calls).
